task_context.research_question: 高电压和快充条件下，如何为锂金属电池设计更有潜力的电解液组合？
task_context.task_scope: Identify the evidence required to compare electrolyte candidates under high-voltage fast-charge conditions and explain why promising formulations work.
design_assumptions: Candidate formulations must be evaluated under comparable cell conditions and protocols.

evidence_targets.description: Electrolyte formulation with explicit solvent, salt and additive composition.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Record each formulation component and amount or concentration with a source anchor and verbatim quote.

evidence_targets.description: Electrochemical test protocol and cell configuration required to interpret performance.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Record voltage range, charge and discharge protocol, cathode loading, lithium foil thickness and temperature when reported.

evidence_targets.description: Decision-relevant cycling performance, including reversible capacity, cycle life and coulombic efficiency.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Record numeric metric values together with cycle index and the linked protocol or cell configuration.

evidence_targets.description: Evidence connecting formulation choices to solvation structure and interphase formation.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Capture the proposed causal link and the observations used to support it.

evidence_targets.description: Characterization evidence for SEI or CEI chemistry, composition and morphology.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Capture the characterization method and observation linked to the relevant formulation.

evidence_targets.description: Calculated descriptors explaining why the formulation may form the proposed solvation or interphase structure, such as binding energy or electrostatic potential.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Capture the calculated descriptor, compared species and explanatory interpretation.

evidence_targets.description: Baseline formulation and explicit comparability conditions for candidate assessment.
evidence_targets.completion_criteria: Identify the baseline and verify that metric definition, protocol and cell configuration are sufficiently comparable.

uncertainty_rules.trigger: A performance value is reported without voltage range, protocol or cell-configuration context.
uncertainty_rules.handling: Do not treat the value as directly comparable; mark the relevant target incomplete and retain a comparability warning.
